_comment: Descripción de cada efecto para ElevenLabs Text to Sound Effects (las mismas usadas en el flow «Promo Café Quindío · efectos de sonido»). Los .wav de public/sfx son la variación elegida, recortada y nivelada a -3 dBFS.

whoosh.text: Short soft airy whoosh, quick upward swipe, smooth and clean, no tail

tap.text: Single soft tap on a phone glass screen, muted crisp click, close-mic, dry

pop.text: Small light bubbly pop, soft and short, friendly UI blip

stamp.text: Rubber stamp pressed firmly on paper, short woody thud, dry close-mic

rise.text: Gentle rustle of tropical leaves rising, soft paper slide, warm and short

notification.text: Warm two-note marimba notification chime, bright and short

reward.text: Cheerful short marimba arpeggio rising, small sparkle, celebratory and light

logo.text: Warm acoustic guitar strum with soft marimba resolve, gentle and short

counter.text: Points counter counting up in a mobile game: fast series of soft bright wooden marimba ticks rising in pitch, starting quick and slowing slightly at the end, light and cheerful, clean UI sound, dry, no reverb tail
